d:
Kahte hain, virasat men mili daulat jindgi ko aasan bana sakti hai, lekin virasat men mile sapnon ko naee oonchaiyon tak pahunchane ke lie hausla, hunar aur athak parishram ki jarurat hoti hai. aisi hi ek kahani hai churamanpur nivasi 39 varshiy amit kumar saini ki, jinhonne pita ke nidhan ke bad na sirph unke chhote se karobar ko bikharne se bachaya, balki apni mehnat se use ek bare vyavsayik brand men badla.
